title: Coalition-Proof Disclosure
abstract: arXiv:2610.15087v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study generalized verifiable disclosure by a sender with type-independent preferences. We first characterize all perfect Bayesian equilibria as partitions of the sender's types into coalitions ordered by payoff. An equilibrium survives our coalition-proofness criterion if no group of types can profitably coordinate an announced deviation that only they are able and willing to join. Coalition-proof equilibria are greedy partitions: at each step, a coalition of the remaining types attains the highest payoff consistent with equilibrium. In our general setting, coalition-proof equilibria may fail to exist. We establish existence under restrictions on preferences and evidence: quasiconcavity with message completeness, betweenness, cheap talk with message completeness, and payoff degradation. translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有类型无关偏好的发送方所进行的广义可验证披露问题。我们首先将所有完美贝叶斯均衡刻画为发送方类型按收益排序划分为联盟的划分。若没有任何类型群体能够有利可图地协调一项只有他们有能力且愿意参与的公开偏离，则该均衡满足我们的抗联盟准则。抗联盟均衡是贪心划分：在每一步中，由剩余类型组成的联盟都会获得与均衡相一致的最高收益。在一般设定下，抗联盟均衡可能不存在。我们在偏好与证据的若干限制条件下证明了其存在性，包括：消息完备性下的拟凹性、中介性、消息完备性下的廉价磋商，以及收益退化。对于证据信息最大丰富的披露博弈，我们证明发送方在抗联盟均衡中的事前收益是分段线性的。
tldr: 本文将可验证披露博弈中的完美贝叶斯均衡刻画为按收益排序的类型联盟划分，提出抗联盟准则并证明抗联盟均衡等价于贪心划分，同时在若干偏好与证据条件下确立了均衡的存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes perfect Bayesian equilibria in generalized verifiable disclosure as payoff-ordered partitions of the sender's types, introduces a coalition-proofness criterion under which equilibria are greedy partitions, and establishes conditions for their existence.
